# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 16 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Market: New Launches & Land Sales

- **New condo sales hit a two-year low in June 2026** - Private home sales fell to just 156 units in June 2026 — the lowest since February 2024 — with zero new projects launching that month; July launches are expected to drive a rebound. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-new-condo-sales-plunged-65-in-june-heres-what-happened/)

- **Bayshore Drive GLS site draws record $2.13 billion top bid** - A Frasers Property-led joint venture submitted the highest offer of $2.128 billion ($1,323 psf ppr) for the Bayshore Drive mixed-use GLS site — the largest bid ever recorded for a GLS plot outside Singapore's CBD — when the tender closed on 15 July 2026 with three bids received. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bayshore-drive-gls-1280-homes-integrated-mrt/)

- **Gillman Barracks to become a new residential neighbourhood** - The historic Gillman Barracks site is planned for redevelopment into a mixed public and private residential estate, with 25 heritage buildings and 8 hectares of greenery to be retained. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gillman-barracks-housing-estate/)

- **People's Park Centre launches third en bloc attempt at $1.48 billion** - The landmark development — Singapore's first-ever GLS parcel, sold in 1967 — has relaunched its collective sale at a guide price of $1.48 billion, $320 million lower than its previous attempts in 2019 and 2022. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/peoples-park-centre-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-320-million-lower-price/)

## HDB Resale: Record Transactions

- **Queenstown 2-room flat sets new national resale record at $696,000** - A high-floor 2-room HDB flat at SkyParc @ Dawson in Queenstown changed hands for S$696,000 on 15 July 2026, setting a new national resale record for the 2-room flat category. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2-room-national-record-broken-as-queenstown-unit-sells-for-s696000/)

- **Tampines executive flat sells for $1.24 million, setting a new town record** - A 31-year-old executive flat at Tampines Arcadia transacted at S$1.24 million, the highest recorded price for an executive flat in Tampines. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/31-year-old-tampines-executive-hdb-flat-sets-towns-new-high-at-s1-24-million/)

## Housing Policy Update

- **Community Care Apartments now open from age 55, with fees cut by up to 75%** - The Government — through MOH, MND and HDB — is lowering the minimum eligible age for Community Care Apartments from 65 to 55 and reducing mandatory monthly service fees by between 18% and 75% to widen access for seniors. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/community-care-apartments-seniors-from-age-55-fees-reduced-by-up-to-75/)
